contract: docs/ai/phase7h-club-admin-mappings-contract.md, section 8 (R12): who may activate, replace and disable a mapping version. The backend suite asserts each row against mayTransitionMappings plus the owner filter (the real resolver's context) and against the real A1 route; the frontend suite asserts it against mayTransition. A platform admin reaches club A's workspace only while also holding club A's admin role, so every club-workspace row of a platform admin is a user who holds both roles. A club mapping is always club A's: in a club workspace the server reads only the workspace's own club's mappings, so another club's mapping never reaches the client.
